move: arrow draws on, trail streaks through, nudges and springs back
how: Dark stage with a drifting dot grid (backgroundPosition 0 to 160px linear over 5s) and a large CTA line. Twice per loop (at 4% and 52%) the arrow shaft and head draw on with DrawSVG expo.out over 0.5s while sliding in from x -40; then a purple trail line draws through from 0-40% to 100% with power2.in and clears with power2.out, a thinner second trail following 0.1s later. The arrow nudges right 26px (power2.inOut) and springs back with elastic.out(1,.5), then at +1.9s flies off right and fades (power3.in). The CTA exits at 92%.
adapt: Change the CTA text and accent colour (#8b93ff); adjust arrow size via the SVG viewBox; keep the two-pulse rhythm and the draw/streak/elastic timings.
port: mount(el, shot) inserts the dot layer, CTA and arrow SVG; animate returns the timeline with pulse(0.04D) and pulse(0.52D). DrawSVG plugin must be registered in the engine; selectors scope to el.
